projects.title: Beagle
projects.hook: Solo build of an evaluation harness for multi-turn LLM agent correction
projects.description: Beagle is a pre-registered evaluation harness that tests whether a correction mechanism actually improves multi-turn agent reliability. Sole architect and developer. Four synthetic environments with computable ground truth (no LLM judge), five controller conditions, and an automated invariant suite enforcing experimental validity — parity between conditions, no controller-state leakage to the agent under test, no condition-dependent data exclusion. Built to test a control-theory-derived correction mechanism of my own design; produced a defensible null result and characterized why: task-level agent error is step-shaped, so derivative-based control has nothing to resolve. Provisional patent applied for.
